_comment: Converter registry for `pxd convert`. Keys starting with _ are ignored. path, env values and deployment_files expand ~ and ${VAR} (from the env block first, then the environment). Optional pins: sha256 (of path) and deployment_sha256 {file: sha256}; a mismatch refuses the tool. Install converters in a directory only maintainers can write (see docs/PERMISSIONS.md). The env block is recorded in every conversion's provenance (manifest and catalogue): never put secrets there. ${VAR} refers to variables defined earlier in the same env block or to the environment.

openms-fileconverter.note: OpenMS FileConverter built with the Thermo RawFileReader bridge (.NET)

mzpeak-convert.note: mzPeak converter for Bruker .d, Thermo .raw and mzML

thermorawfileparser.why: ThermoRawFileParser 2.0.0 writes wrong mzML index offsets (validated after conversion when allowed)
